card.name: Numbers just before distance units
card.fires_on: The space or digit right before a number that will be followed by a distance unit like miles or kilometers. It appears in geography, astronomy and weather text.

modes.label: Distance figure ahead
modes.description: The space or digit inside a number that is about to be followed by miles or kilometers.
modes.example: about every<< >>60 miles. One square kilometer

modes.label: Table separators
modes.description: The divider in a data table just before a distance or angle value.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict mile and kilometer unit words next.
card.plain: It fires when a number is coming that will be a distance in miles or kilometers.
